summary: Quote every placeholder the package's and examples' prompt spans substitute into a shell command
acceptance: Every inline-exec span in the shipped prompts quotes its substituted placeholder, and the package's prompts render intact from a state root whose path carries a space or a backslash.
tests: every package prompt's spans read their artifacts under a state root path carrying a space
every package prompt's spans read their artifacts under a state root path carrying a backslash
pins: a placeholder substituted into a span's command reaches sh as text the engine neither quotes nor escapes
notes: Reduces the win32 repro to a case this suite runs: three harnessPrompts cases and one harnessChain case red on the Windows lane over a backslash-bearing tmpdir. A span with an `|| echo` fallback fails silently rather than refusing, so the new cases assert the artifact's content reached the prompt, not merely that the render did not throw.
